description: Starts the workflow when Airtable events occur

properties.name: baseId
properties.description: The Airtable Base in which to operate on

properties.name: triggerField
properties.description: A Created Time or Last Modified Time field that will be used to sort records. If you do not have a Created Time or Last Modified Time field in your schema, please create one, because without this field trigger will not work correctly.

properties.name: downloadAttachments
properties.description: Whether the attachment fields define in 'Download Fields' will be downloaded

properties.name: downloadFieldNames
properties.description: Name of the fields of type 'attachment' that should be downloaded. Multiple ones can be defined separated by comma. Case sensitive.

options.name: fields
options.description: Fields to be included in the response. Multiple ones can be set separated by comma. Example: name, id. By default just the trigger field will be included.

options.name: formula
options.description: Formulas may involve functions, numeric operations, logical operations, and text operations that operate on fields. More info here.

options.name: viewId
options.description: The name or ID of a view in the table. If set, only the records in that view will be returned.

subtitle: ={{$parameter["event"]}}
